The '''Hyperwave beacon scrambler''' was a device capable of disrupting all holotechnology within its range, including [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomms]], [[holoscanner]]s, [[Holocamera/Legends|holocameras]] and [[holo-probe]]s. An extremely powerful beacon scrambler could block communications over the entire planet, while also making it invisible to conventional methods. [[The Shroud (Human)|The Shroud]] used the best scrambler credits could buy at [[Obus VI]] to protect his base [[The Coil (Obus VI)|The Coil]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hyperwave beacon scrambler is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during '''Interlude: Shroud of Memory'''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
